title: Staggered rollout risk & cost-velocity sheet
summary: Working tracker for phased rollouts that balances cost (per-token $), latency SLOs, and velocity of user ramp. Unlike previous checklists this sheet focuses on 'risk corridor' boundaries per phase and a velocity ticker to gate movement. Goals: 1) make go/no-go explicit for each phase using numeric thresholds; 2) track unit economics delta vs baseline; 3) list actionable mitigations prioritized by impact to latency and cost.
kpi_rows: KPI | Target | Baseline | Current | Owner | Cadence
Avg cost per 1k tokens ($) | <= 0.45 | 0.62 | 0.50 | Sofia Ruiz | daily
KV cache hit rate | >= 30% | 18% | 25% | Daniel Kim | hourly
Rollout adoption (active cohorts) | phase-dependent | N/A | 3 cohorts | Growth | daily
Quality regressions (eval set) | 0 | 2 regressions | 1 | Research/Applied ML | per-deploy
phase_gate_matrix: Phase | % traffic | Max cost delta vs baseline | Latency corridor (P95) | KV cache min | Go/No-go rule
Phase 0 (canary) | 0.1% | +200% | <= 500ms | 0% | Manual go if error <= 1% and latency <= 500ms
Phase 1 (pilot) | 1% | +100% | <= 420ms | >= 10% | Auto-gate if cost delta < +80% and P95 <= 420ms
Phase 2 (ramped) | 10% | +50% | <= 380ms | >= 20% | Gate if cost delta < +40% and P95 <= 380ms and KV >=20%
Phase 3 (scale) | 50% | +20% | <= 350ms | >= 30% | Gate if cost delta < +15% and P95 <=350ms and errors <0.3%
velocity_ticker: Ticker note: updates every 6 hours; green means conditions met for next phase, amber = partial mitigations required, red = hold
Current state: AMBER (need cost optimizations and KV hit tuning)
Primary blocker: cost per 1k tokens trending +11% vs yesterday after model calibration

(A5) Research to run a short A/B for kernel selection heuristics on p99-heavy requests (owner: Research Eng) — impact: p99 improvements — due: 2026-03-10
contingency_checklist: If error rate spikes > 1%: revert to last stable model manifest and open incident bridge (incident runbook: CONFLUENCE-IR-08)
If cost per 1k tokens > +100% baseline for > 2h: throttle non-essential batch jobs and trigger quantized-variant fallback
If KV cache drops below phase min for > 1h: enable warm-prefix preloads and pause new cohort onboarding
If P95 > phase upper bound for 30m: trigger canary rollback and notify product ops + SRE
If SLA breaches observed in 24h window: escalate to Eng Director and freeze rollout schedule
notes: Working assumptions: baseline cost measured on 2025-11-01 after optimizer v2.0 landed. Velocity gating assumes ability to toggle quantization and fallback models without retraining. Use this sheet as the canonical pre-launch gating artifact for any pilot that increases traffic >0.5% of org traffic. Crosslink to onboarding checklist: Confluence page above. Open questions: do we want per-tenant gating for enterprise (ticket JIRA-2501) or a single global gate?
